timeline.labelEn: A permanent European settlement is established near New York Harbor
timeline.labelDe: Gründung einer dauerhaften europäischen Siedlung am Hafen von New York

questions.notes: Card statement is true: New York City 40.71° N, Naples 40.84° N (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Naples). Accept answers around 40–41° N.

source.title: Emergency crew rescuing Steven Trotter & Lori Martin after they went over the Falls in a barrel

questions.notes: Card prints the English "and" (typo for "und") between the names. The 12-foot barrel was welded from two hot-water-heater halves and coated in Kevlar.

questions.en: Whose engagement ring cost around £30,000 in 1981 and consisted of a blue 12-carat sapphire in a white-gold setting, surrounded by 14 diamonds?

timeline.labelEn: Prince Charles and Lady Diana Spencer become engaged
timeline.labelDe: Prinz Charles und Lady Diana Spencer verloben sich

source.title: Engagement ring of Diana, Princess of Wales

questions.notes: The source confirms the 12-carat oval blue Ceylon sapphire, 14 diamonds and 18-carat white gold (by Garrard); it does not give the 1981 price. Since 2010 the ring is worn by Catherine, Princess of Wales.
